rationale: No supported optimization safely applies while preserving coverage. The build matrix already documents that every appliance/platform combination must report independently, so enabling fail-fast (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST) is contraindicated: its contraindications include "Every matrix outcome is required" and "Full failure diagnostics are required," which match the workflow's explicit comment. Stale-run cancellation (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE) is already implemented via concurrency.cancel-in-progress: true. A custom timeout (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT) cannot be set safely because CI history is not_a_measured_baseline with no completed runs, so the precondition "Representative successful-duration history exists" is unmet, and firmware/esphome builds risk exceeding an arbitrary limit. Dependency caching (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) has no clear dependency-install step or lockfile to key a cache on in this firmware build workflow.
